how_to_apply: Visit the official Public Service Commission, West Bengal website at psc.wb.gov.in.
Locate Advertisement No. 22/2024 for Sub-Surveyor recruitment under the Directorate of Land Records & Surveys.
Read the detailed advertisement and eligibility conditions.
Open the online application facility for the Sub-Surveyor post.
Complete the required candidate registration or sign in to the existing account.
Enter the prescribed personal, educational and contact information.
Provide details of the Survey Engineering Diploma or Surveyor ITI qualification.
If applying through the ITI route, enter the required Survey and Settlement experience details.
Declare the applicable reservation or category information and provide the required supporting details.
Enter the details of a valid photo identity document.
Review the application carefully before final submission.
Pay the Rs. 110 application fee and applicable service charges unless exempt.
Complete final submission by 9 November 2026 at 3:00 PM.
Save or print the submitted application for future reference.

Application Warning: Submission of more than one application for the same post is prohibited and may result in cancellation of candidature. Candidates should ensure that all personal, qualification and category details are accurate before final submission.
important_instructions: Paper I is a conventional examination carrying 50 marks. Paper II contains 200 objective questions for 200 marks. Paper I requires at least 30% qualifying marks. Paper II marks are considered only for candidates who qualify in Paper I. The Commission may prescribe qualifying marks for Paper II. Final merit is prepared using Paper II marks alone. Each incorrect answer in Paper II carries a deduction of 0.25 mark. Where two or more candidates obtain equal Paper II marks, the older candidate receives preference. The examination date will be announced separately.

Eligible West Bengal candidates may claim the prescribed SC, ST, OBC Non-Creamy Layer or EWS reservation. SC, ST, OBC and EWS candidates from other states may apply against unreserved vacancies. OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates must submit renewed or revalidated certificates when required. EWS candidates must provide the prescribed Income and Asset Certificate. Applicants must possess valid supporting certificates by the closing date for online applications.

The notified sports include Athletics, Badminton, Basketball, Cricket, Football, Hockey, Swimming, Table Tennis, Volleyball, Tennis, Weightlifting, Wrestling, Boxing, Cycling, Gymnastics, Judo, Rifle Shooting, Kabaddi, Kho-Kho and Archery.
Eligible candidates must produce the prescribed sports certificate and applicable supporting forms at document verification.
Candidates with benchmark disabilities and prescribed writing limitations may be eligible for a scribe and compensatory time under the applicable rules.
Applicants requesting a scribe or compensatory time must provide the relevant medical certificate and follow the prescribed application-stage requirements.

Applications are accepted online only. All essential qualifications must be fulfilled by the application closing date. The applicant's date of birth must match the Madhyamik or equivalent certificate. Experience claimed under the Surveyor ITI route must be supported by valid certificates. Reservation claims must be supported by certificates obtained within the prescribed period. Only one online application is permitted for the post. Selection-related updates and examination dates will be published on the official WBPSC website. Candidates must carry the prescribed original photo identity document and a valid admit card to the examination. Mobile phones, smartwatches, Bluetooth devices and other unauthorized electronic communication devices are prohibited at the examination venue.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC Sub Surveyor Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy one of the two notified educational qualification routes. The experience requirement applies to the ITI Surveyor route, not to the three-year Survey Engineering Diploma route. Candidates applying through the ITI route must possess one year of experience in Survey and Settlement work involving modern survey techniques. The notification requires familiarity with: Differential Global Positioning System (DGPS) and/or Electronic Total Stations (ETS). Modern methods of surveying. Large-scale mapping and land records preparation. The experience must be obtained from an eligible Government-empanelled organization or an Indian GIS/surveying company recognized under the Digital India Land Records Modernisation Programme, Department of Land Resources, Government of India, with at least three years of experience in preparing large-scale maps and land records. Experience Certificate: Applicants claiming experience must obtain a certificate from the competent authority specifying the employment period, field of experience, duties performed and relevant pay details. The experience must have been gained through full-time relevant employment by the application closing date. Ability to read, write and speak Bengali is an essential requirement for the Sub-Surveyor post. This requirement is not mandatory for candidates whose mother tongue is Nepali. Candidates whose Bengali-language performance is found inadequate may have their candidature cancelled.

rows.required_qualification: Passed Madhyamik or equivalent examination and completed a three-year Diploma in Survey Engineering from a recognized institute affiliated with AICTE or the West Bengal State Council of Technical Education.

Passed Madhyamik or equivalent examination and completed a two-year Surveyor certificate course from a recognized Industrial Training Institute, along with one year of prescribed experience in Survey and Settlement work.

content_sections.text: The recruitment examination comprises Paper I and Paper II . Paper I is qualifying, while final merit is prepared using Paper II marks only. Paper I - Bengali/Nepali conventional examination. Paper II - Objective examination covering English, Elementary Mathematics and Survey Engineering. Preparation of the final merit list using Paper II marks of candidates qualifying Paper I and meeting the prescribed Paper II standard. Verification of educational, experience, reservation and other eligibility documents. Final recommendation subject to fulfilment of recruitment conditions. Important Merit Rule: Candidates must score at least 30% in Paper I for their Paper II marks to be considered. Paper I marks are not included in final merit. WBPSC may separately prescribe qualifying marks in Paper II.

content_sections.text: Candidates must retain the documents supporting their eligibility and produce them whenever required by the Commission. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The West Bengal Public Service Commission (WBPSC) is conducting the recruitment for the Sub-Surveyor position under advertisement number 22/2024 for filling up 1145 vacancies.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Sub-Surveyor post?
faq.answer: A total of 1145 vacancies have been officially announced by the West Bengal Public Service Commission for the Sub-Surveyor recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for WBPSC Sub-Surveyor?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Madhyamik Examination or equivalent, along with a 3 years Diploma in Survey Engineering or a 2 years certificate course for Surveyor with 1 year experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 21 and 45 years of age as on 01.01.2024. Age relaxations are provided for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary scale for the Sub-Surveyor post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary as per Level - 7, ranging from Rs. 24,700 to Rs. 63,900 per month along with admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. When does the online application process start and end?
faq.answer: The online application process commences on 20 October 2026 and concludes on 9 November 2026. Fee payment must also be completed by 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for WBPSC Sub-Surveyor?
faq.answer: Yes, General and OBC candidates are required to pay Rs. 110/- plus service charges, whereas SC/ST candidates of West Bengal and PwBD candidates are exempt from fee payment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises Paper-I (Conventional type Bengali/Nepali test) and Paper-II (Objective type MCQs on English, Elementary Mathematics, and Survey Engineering), followed by a final merit list.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any edit window available for corrections?
faq.answer: Yes, an edit window for making necessary corrections in the submitted online application form will remain available from 11 November 2026 to 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for WBPSC Sub-Surveyor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can submit their online applications through the official WBPSC website at https://psc.wb.gov.in before the closing date.
